meeting.title: Initech onboarding — readiness check
meeting.summary: Initech readiness check ahead of go-live. Most outstanding work sits on Initech's side: their finance team needs to sign off on the procurement workflow, IT needs to provision service accounts, and Bill (their PM) needs to schedule the kickoff with their CFO. Caroline has one item — chase the legal redlines on the DPA.
action_items: Bill will get finance team sign-off on the procurement workflow by Friday
Bill will have IT provision the three service accounts (read, write, admin) by next Wednesday
Bill will schedule the kickoff meeting with their CFO before May 12
Samir to send the corrected user list (the previous one had duplicates) by Monday
Samir to confirm the production environment whitelist with their network team
Caroline will chase legal on the DPA redlines and report back by Thursday
key_decisions: Go-live target stays at May 19, conditional on the IT provisioning landing on time
discussion_flow: Bill walked through outstanding internal items at Initech
Samir flagged the duplicate users in the previous list
Caroline confirmed the DPA is the only vendor-side blocker
meeting.notes: Bill is highly engaged and clearly running this on his side. Samir is detail-oriented and already caught a list error before it caused problems downstream — keep that feedback loop tight.

transcript.speaker: Caroline Jaworsky
transcript.text: Hi Bill, hi Samir. Readiness check — let's go through the outstanding items. Bill, where are you on procurement?

transcript.speaker: Bill Lumbergh
transcript.text: Yeah, so, I'm gonna need finance to sign off on the workflow. I'll have that by Friday. And IT needs to provision the three service accounts — read, write, admin — should be done by Wednesday next week.

transcript.speaker: Bill Lumbergh
transcript.text: Also, I'll get a kickoff scheduled with our CFO before May 12. He wants to be looped in before go-live.

transcript.speaker: Samir Nagheenanajar
transcript.text: On the user list — the one we sent had duplicates. I'll send the corrected version Monday. And I need to confirm the prod whitelist with our network team.

transcript.speaker: Caroline Jaworsky
transcript.text: Great catch on the duplicates. From our side, the only outstanding is legal — I'm chasing the DPA redlines, I'll have an update by Thursday.

transcript.speaker: Bill Lumbergh
transcript.text: Good. So we're still tracking to May 19?

transcript.speaker: Caroline Jaworsky
transcript.text: Yes, conditional on the IT provisioning landing on time. If that slips, go-live slips with it.
